get.description: Retrieve the oldest entries still available in your app's journal, up to `count`.

get.description: Retrieve the most recent entries in your app's journal, up to `count`. Entries are returned oldest first.

parameters.description: The number of entries to return, from 1 to 100.

parameters.description: The ID of an account that has installed your app. When set, only entries for that account are returned.

post.description: Fetch up to 100 journal entries by offset in a single request. Offsets that can't be fetched don't fail the request; they're listed in `errors` and counted in `numErrors`.

parameters.description: The ID of an account that has installed your app. When set, only entries for that account are returned.

get.description: Retrieve up to `count` entries that follow the given offset. Pass the last entry's `currentOffset` to fetch the next page.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of entries to return, from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The `currentOffset` of the last entry you processed. Entries after this offset are returned. If the offset has expired or doesn't exist, the batch is empty.

parameters.name: installPortalId
parameters.description: The ID of an account that has installed your app. When set, only entries for that account are returned.

get.description: Retrieve the oldest entry still available in your app's journal. Use `installPortalId` to limit it to one account.

parameters.description: The ID of the installation portal to filter the journal entries by. This is an integer value.

get.description: Retrieve the most recent entry in your app's journal. Use `installPortalId` to limit it to one account.

get.description: Retrieve the entry that follows the given offset. Fails with a `404` if the offset has expired or doesn't exist.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The `currentOffset` of the last entry you processed. The entry after this offset is returned.

parameters.name: installPortalId
parameters.description: The ID of the portal installation. This is an integer value used to identify the specific portal installation for which the webhook journal entries are being retrieved.

204.description: No journal entry exists after the given offset

get.description: Retrieve the status of a snapshot request. Use the `snapshotStatusId` returned when the snapshot was requested.

parameters.name: statusId
parameters.description: The `snapshotStatusId` returned when the snapshot was requested.

post.description: Capture the current state of up to 200 CRM objects. Each snapshot is written to your journal as a `SNAPSHOT` entry, and its progress can be checked with the status endpoint using the returned `snapshotStatusId`. This operation is exempt from daily and ten-secondly rate limits.

get.description: Retrieve all of your app's subscriptions.

post.description: Create a subscription, or update the existing one with the same subscription type, object type, and account. The request body sets which actions and objects are recorded in your journal.
Add a filter to a subscription. When a subscription has filters, only events that match at least one of them are recorded in your journal.

get.description: Retrieve all filters attached to a subscription.

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the subscription for which to retrieve filters.

parameters.name: filterId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the filter to retrieve.

delete.description: Delete a filter from its subscription. This can't be undone.

parameters.name: filterId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the filter to delete. It must be an integer.

delete.description: Delete all of your app's subscriptions for an account, along with their filters. Changes in that account are no longer recorded in your journal.

parameters.name: portalId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the portal whose webhook journal subscription is to be deleted.

associatedObjectTypeIds.description: An array of strings representing the IDs of the associated object types involved in the action.

listIds.description: An array of integers (int64 format) representing the IDs of the lists involved in the action.

objectIds.description: An array of integers (int64 format) representing the IDs of the objects involved in the action.

properties.description: An array of strings representing the properties to be overridden or specified for the action.

eventTypeId.description: A string representing the unique identifier for the event type that the subscription is related to.

properties.description: An array of strings specifying the properties associated with the event type that should be included in the subscription.

subscriptionType.description: A string indicating the type of subscription, which is 'APP_LIFECYCLE_EVENT' by default.

associatedObjectTypeIds.description: An array of strings representing the type identifiers of the associated objects in the subscription.

objectIds.description: The IDs of specific objects to track. Use an empty array to track all objects of this type.

objectTypeId.description: A string representing the type identifier of the object involved in the subscription.

portalId.description: An integer representing the unique identifier of the HubSpot portal.

subscriptionType.description: A string indicating the type of subscription, which is 'ASSOCIATION' for this component.

inputs.description: The offsets (UUIDs) of the journal entries to fetch, up to 100 per request. Use the `currentOffset` values returned by other journal endpoints. If any value is not a valid UUID, the whole request is rejected with a `400`. Offsets that can't be fetched, including ones with no matching entry for your app (or for `installPortalId` when it is set), don't fail the request: each one appears in `errors` with the offset in `context.offset`, and `numErrors` counts them. An empty list returns an empty result.
